name: Shoko
description:
A Jellyfin plugin to integrate [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org/docs/) with [Shoko Server](https://shokoanime.com/downloads/shoko-server/).
## Read this before installing
**This plugin requires that you have already set up and are using Shoko Server**, and that the files you intend to include in Jellyfin are **indexed** (and optionally managed) by Shoko Server. **Otherwise, the plugin won't be able to provide metadata for your files**, since there is no metadata to find for them.
overview: Manage your anime from Jellyfin using metadata from Shoko

`feat`: **Add setting to always use episode title as movie title for TMDB movies**:

Added a new opt-in _advanced_ setting which, when enabled, uses the episode-level title as-is for Shoko/AniDB "movies" that have one or more TMDB movie links, instead of composing the title as "<series title>: <episode title>". Also added some deduplication logic for movie titles when the season-level and episode-level titles resolve to the same text, case-insensitively.

It is not hooked up exactly as suggested in the issue because the "<series title>: <episode title>" rule predates the more "proper" TMDB title support and was originally meant for when we only had AniDB titles, where the movie title was split across the AniDB anime and AniDB episode. That rule remains the default and still applies for entries without a TMDB movie link, so existing setups are unaffected. The new behavior only kicks in when the setting is enabled and the entry is a movie or entity that carries at least one TMDB movie link; the rest is up to the user, since their title settings need to resolve the episode-level title the way they want it to, e.g. by configuring the Shoko group "Movie / Film" title settings.

Closes #112

Only compatible with **10.11.z**.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/ShokoAnime/Shokofin/releases/tag/v6.0.5-dev.30) for more info.

`feat`: **Add Jellyfin 12 compatibility (#110)**:

Adds Jellyfin 12.0 support while still supporting Jellyfin 10.10 and 10.11.

- Adds the `net10.0` target using the Jellyfin `12.0.0-rc5` packages.
- Updates alternate-version and playlist handling for the Jellyfin 12 APIs.
- Produces separate packages for Jellyfin 10.10, 10.11, and 12.
- Hardens the multi-target release workflow.

All three targets build and package fine. I have been using this branch on Jellyfin 12 RC5 since its release without any problems.

Closes #108
